name: Interactive Health Network
summary: Interactive Health Network, doing business as House of Mohan, distributes incense in the United States. Incense is composed of aromatic biotic materials, which release fragrant smoke when burned. It distributes 70 flavors, designer scents, zodiac signs scents, and a line of charcoal and natural herb incense. The company was formerly known as HPC POS System, Corp. and changed its name to Interactive Health Network in April 2014. Interactive Health Network was founded in 1995 and is based in Washington, District of Columbia.
